title: the allow-list names the owner's role, not a person; the install runbook says building the images needs memory
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the repository and by the card's checks; no image was built and no memory was measured.

findings.claim: the memory `make images` needs is not measured: no peak is recorded, and CI's compose job builds the images on ubuntu-24.04 without a recorded size or peak for that job, so the install runbook gives the symptom and two remedies without a figure
findings.expected: a measured peak memory for `make images` on each build host kind, cited by the runbook
findings.happened: a 64 GB Windows host's Linux VM went down during `make images` (the integrator, 2026-11-20); nothing in the repository measures the build's memory

findings.claim: the owner's personal name is still written in 5 tracked files under trialbox/ outside the allow-list (listed with counts in the card's pull request); D-1352 changed only the allow-list and the two tests that read its owner text
findings.expected: for the integrator and the owner to rule whether those files name the role too
findings.happened: listed, not changed, as the integrator asked; tests/unit/test_supply_chain.py asserts the name in known-image-findings.md and changes with that file
